我们收到的第一批数据难以理解，但随后的传输让这些信息慢慢拼凑到了一起。我们推测，在这条裂缝的另一边，时间的流动要快得多，事实上，我们正在接收来自裂缝另一边的实时通信。

结果加是每天处理大约一个单词。以下是我们目前收到的报告。

“我们观测……”

“道歉……方法……恶劣……”

“紧急……”

“理解……”

这些简短的信息几被严重的噪音和无法解读的数据几乎淹没了。

谁都不知道裂隙探球的[Explorer.GetCrew]究竟处于何等的危险之中。

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 1000–1095 全部事件、资源门槛、隐藏事件 1095 与 astral_planes.45，以及裂隙的生成来源（水晶球情境）。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 1000–1095 with resource gates, hidden event 1095, astral_planes.45 and the rift's spawn source (the crystal sphere situation).

label.zh: 用人工智能解读或用电磁脉冲夺回控制
label.en: Decode with A.I. or take control with an E.M.P.

note.zh: 1000：用人工智能检测隐藏规律（→ 1005 家园）；或花 1000 能量币对锚链释放电磁脉冲（→ 1010 重获控制）。1010 之后可再提供人工智能支援（→ 1006 家园，难度较高，汇入同一主线 1015）或趁机逃离（→ 1025）。
note.en: 1000: use A.I. to look for hidden patterns (→ 1005 Home), or spend 1000 energy on an E.M.P. through the anchor cord (→ 1010 Taking Control). After 1010 you may add A.I. assistance (→ 1006 Home, higher difficulty, rejoining the main line at 1015) or escape at once (→ 1025).

label.en: Open the doorway or seal it

note.zh: 1020：打开传送门（立即结束探索，2 天后隐藏事件 1095 在银河核心生成形态之系统并以天然虫洞取代这个裂隙所在位置，再过 1 天触发 astral_planes.45 “古怪虫洞”）；或在掌握虫洞稳定科技并花 500 星界丝缕后封印它（→ 1030，该星系获得矿藏 d_crystal_rift）。
note.en: 1020: open the doorway (the exploration ends at once; 2 days later hidden event 1095 spawns the Formless system at the galactic core, replaces the rift with a natural wormhole, destroys the rift, and one day later fires astral_planes.45 “Strange Wormhole”); or, with Wormhole Stabilization and 500 astral threads, seal it (→ 1030, the system gains the deposit d_crystal_rift).

notes.zh: 这个裂隙不会随机抽取（randomized = no，flags = crystal_rift）：它只由“研究水晶球”情境完成时的事件 astral_situation.5 在水晶球星系中生成（astral_planes_situation_events.txt:61-71，common/situations/06_astral_planes_situations.txt:268）。
notes.en: This rift is never drawn randomly (randomized = no, flags = crystal_rift): it is spawned in the crystal sphere system only by astral_situation.5 when the “Study the Crystal Sphere” situation completes (astral_planes_situation_events.txt:61-71, common/situations/06_astral_planes_situations.txt:268).

texts.zh:
在裂隙的另一边有什么东西控制住了球体使我们的回收装置失效了。

我们收到的第一批数据难以理解，但随后的传输让这些信息慢慢拼凑到了一起。我们推测，在这条裂缝的另一边，时间的流动要快得多，事实上，我们正在接收来自裂缝另一边的实时通信。

结果加是每天处理大约一个单词。以下是我们目前收到的报告。

“我们观测……”

“道歉……方法……恶劣……”

“紧急……”

“理解……”

这些简短的信息几被严重的噪音和无法解读的数据几乎淹没了。

谁都不知道裂隙探球的[Explorer.GetCrew]究竟处于何等的危险之中。

可能可以通过锚索发送电磁脉冲来重新建立联系并重新掌控我们的控制系统。
texts.en:
Something on the far side of the Rift has taken hold of the Sphere and disabled our retraction device.

The first parcels of data we received were unintelligible, but subsequent transfers are slowly piecing these messages together. We speculate the flow of time is much faster on the other side of this rift, and we are in fact receiving communication in real-time from across the breach.

The result is the processing of approximately one word per day. The following report is what we have received so far.

"we observe..."

"apology... method... unkind..."

"emergency..."

"understand..."

These brief messages are hidden amongst heavy noise and incomprehensible data.

Who knows what danger the [Explorer.GetCrew] of the Rift Sphere is in.

It may be possible to re-establish contact and regain control by sending an electromagnetic pulse through the anchor cord in an effort to reset our control systems.

texts.zh:
我们的裂隙探球发回的报告没有包含我们[Explorer.GetScientistPlural]的[Leader.GetMechanicalBiological]签名。

在裂隙的另一边有什么东西控制住了球体使我们的回收装置失效了。

我们收到的第一批数据难以理解，但随后的传输让这些信息慢慢拼凑到了一起。我们推测，在这条裂缝的另一边，时间的流动要快得多，事实上，我们正在接收来自裂缝另一边的实时通信。

结果加是每天处理大约一个单词。以下是我们目前收到的报告。

“我们观测……”

“道歉……方法……恶劣……”

“紧急……”

“理解……”

这些简短的信息几被严重的噪音和无法解读的数据几乎淹没了。

谁都不知道裂隙探球的[Explorer.GetCrew]究竟处于何等的危险之中。

可能可以通过锚索发送电磁脉冲来重新建立联系并重新掌控我们的控制系统。
texts.en:
The report received from our Rift Sphere contains no record of our [Explorer.GetScientistPlural]'s [Leader.GetMechanicalBiological] signature.

Something on the far side of the Rift has taken hold of the Sphere and disabled our retraction device.

The first parcels of data we received were unintelligible, but subsequent transfers are slowly piecing these messages together. We speculate the flow of time is much faster on the other side of this rift, and we are in fact receiving communication in real-time from across the breach.

The result is the processing of approximately one word per day. The following report is what we have received so far.

"we observe..."

"apology... method... unkind..."

"emergency..."

"understand..."

These brief messages are hidden amongst heavy noise and incomprehensible data.

Who knows what danger the [Explorer.GetCrew] of the Rift Sphere is in.

It may be possible to re-establish contact and regain control by sending an electromagnetic pulse through the anchor cord in an effort to reset our control systems.

label.zh: 用人工智能检测隐藏规律。
label.en: Utilize A.I. to check for hidden patterns.

notes.zh: 探球被另一侧的存在抓住、收回装置失效，因此第一章没有“放弃”的选项；只能解读数据或用电磁脉冲夺回控制。
notes.en: Something on the far side holds the Sphere and its retraction device is disabled, so the first chapter has no “abandon” option; only decoding the data or an E.M.P. to regain control.

texts.zh:
我们能破译出的后两个单词是“家园”和“目击”。令人惊讶的是，随着我们对这些怪异数据理解的深入，我们还发现了嵌入在噪音中的视觉数据的存在。

这些图像中可以拼凑出我们整个星系的有赢，还有另一个小得多、但密度异常大的星系的图像。在两者之间，有一系列的星界裂隙。我们明白这是从我们的维度到另一个地方的路线图。

在我们星系的图像中，有一个小光点异常地突出。后来的分析证实这是我们的家园，[Explorer.GetHomeWorldName]，在闪闪发光。在邻近的宇宙中也发现了类似的光。

他们在告诉我们该去哪里。

为了避免数据损坏或丢失，我们接收的数据已经超出了计算机的合理处理能力。我们应该优先考虑我们想要保存的信息类型。
texts.en:
The next two words we were able to decode were "home" and "witness". Amazingly, as our understanding of the alien data improves, we also discovered the existence of visual data embedded within the noise.

A projection of our galaxy could be pieced together from the images, along with a second image of a much smaller, yet unusually dense system. Between the two, there stretched a series of Astral Rifts. We understood that this was a roadmap from our dimension to somewhere else.

A small point of light was abnormally highlighted inside the image of our galaxy. Later analysis confirmed this was our Homeworld, [Explorer.GetHomeWorldName], shining brightly. A similar light was discovered to be marked in the neighboring universe.

They are showing us where to go.

We're receiving more data than our computers can reasonably handle before it becomes corrupted or lost. We should prioritize the type of information we'd like to preserve.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的母星的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of your homeworld appears here.

texts.zh:
更多的图像。

我们非常详细地看到了这个外星家园的编年史。

这些生物是几千年前由聚集在一个巨大的星界裂隙附近的气体和能量的偶然结合而形成的。他们能像大气层的一部分般自由地进出他们的星球。

在每个生命周期结束时，它们的精华会分散到行星上，重新诞生。天空中的城市崛起，陨落，又复兴。文明是在先前文明的基础上形成的，其知识是由这些祖先粒子在物理上维持的。时间流逝的程度被可靠地估计为比我们已知宇宙的历史还要大的数量级。

最后，我们看到了一个觉醒的高等生物的文明。它们的生理机能比我们能想到的任何技术都要先进。

我们在数据库中记录了这个新物种，命名为无形者。

“繁荣……”

再一次，我们接收的数据比我们的计算机在损坏或丢失之前能够合理处理的数据还要多。我们应该优先考虑我们想要保存的信息类型。
texts.en:
More images.

A chronicle of this alien homeworld was shown to us in great detail.

These beings formed millennia ago by a chance combination of gases and energy that accumulated nearby a massive Astral Rift. They flow freely in and out of their planet as if they were part of its atmosphere.

At the end of each life cycle, their essence disperses back into the planet and gets born anew. Cities in the sky rose, fell, and rose again. Civilizations formed on top of previous civilizations with the knowledge physically maintained by these ancestral particles. The degree of the time passing was safely estimated to be magnitudes greater than the history of our known universe.

In the end, we behold a civilization of awakened higher beings. Their physiology alone is more advanced than any technology we could conceive.

We have logged this new species in our databases as the Formless.

"flourishing..."

Once again, we're receiving more data than our computers can reasonably handle before it becomes corrupted or lost. We should prioritize the type of information we'd like to preserve.

texts.zh:
它们的气态母行星向我们展示了越来越多的细节。这一次，我们看到了它的个体居民。光、气体和星界物质构成的存在从附近的裂隙泄漏出来，生活在一个可谓是乌托邦的地方。

最终，一座伟大的建筑建成了。这项令人难以置信的工程直接从他们的星球延伸到裂隙，使他们能够轻松地在这个维度和无数其他维度之间旅行。在这两个位面之间有这样一条星界管路存在了这么长时间，他们塑造了许多裂隙来满足他们的特殊需求。他们的社会在多个维度之间延伸，殖民整个宇宙，就像我们殖民新行星一样。

然而，他们最大的成就也是他们最大的灾难。他们的帝国扩张得比星界管路所能维持的还要远。这个巨型结构越来越亮，直到目不能视，最终在一次跨越维度的灾难中猛烈地爆炸，彻底摧毁了他们的文明。

“破碎的亲缘……”

“战争……”

”帮助我们……”

我们的裂隙探球被强行拉出裂谷。一个维度传送门在[solar_system.GetName]恒星系中徐徐打开。
texts.en:
Their gaseous homeworld was revealed to us in more and more detail. This time, we see its individual inhabitants. Beings of light, gas, and astral material leaked from the nearby rift are living in what could easily be described as a utopia.

Eventually, a great structure was raised. An incredible piece of engineering, it stretched directly from their planet into the rift, allowing them to easily travel between this dimension and countless others. With such an astral conduit existing for so long between the planes, they have shaped many rifts to fit their specific needs. Their society stretched between a multitude of dimensions, colonizing entire universes as we would new planets.

However, their greatest achievement was also their greatest disaster. Their empire spread further than the astral conduit could maintain. Brighter and brighter the megastructure grew until the sight of it was difficult to look upon without shielding one's eyes, until it finally burst violently in a dimension-spanning explosion that fractured their civilization.

"shattered kin..."

"war..."

"help us..."

Our Rift Sphere has been forcibly ejected from the Rift. A dimensional portal is now opening in the [solar_system.GetName] System.

label.zh: 我们打开了一个传送门……

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]内附近的晶体裂隙处出现了一个异常的虫洞。

我们只能推测这是无形异使打开的一个星门，为他们带来援军。我们检测到另一侧的恒星系已经从其他地方被拉入我们的位面。

如果我们选择进入这个地方，我们应该准备我们最强大的舰队。
texts.en:
An anomalous wormhole has appeared nearby the Crystal Rift, in [From.GetName].

We can only assume that it is a gateway opened by the Formless to bring them aid. We detect the system on the other side has been pulled into our dimension from somewhere else.

We should prepare our strongest fleets if we choose to enter this place.

texts.zh: 我们发现了一个异常的虫洞。无论我们的舰船试图靠近多近，都会被一股未知的力量推开。在[From.GetName]恒星系中发生了非常奇怪的事情。
texts.en: We have discovered an anomalous wormhole. No matter how close our vessels attempt to proceed, we are being repelled by an unknown force. Something very odd is happening in the [From.GetName] system.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]发现了一个异常的虫洞。传感器显示它直接通往星系的中心。这怎么可能？
texts.en: We have discovered an anomalous wormhole in [From.GetName]. Sensors detect it is a direct pathway to the center of the galaxy. How is that possible?

label.zh: 舰队穿过奇异虫洞进入“无形异使”星系时
label.en: When a fleet passes through the strange wormhole into the Formless system

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, this system's name appears here.

label.zh: 古怪虫洞：通往形态之系统
label.en: Strange Wormhole: the way to the Formless system

note.zh: 打开传送门后裂隙被销毁，星系中出现通往银河核心形态之系统的天然虫洞。这是打开者自己的首次遭遇。
note.en: Opening the doorway destroys the rift; a natural wormhole to the Formless system, at the galactic core, appears here. This is the opener's own first encounter.

texts.zh:
一个最近在我们首都星系构建起来的星门将我们的人民置于高度的危险之中。

幸运的是，我们通过研究星界裂隙得到的科技可以用来永远的封上这个危险。

究竟是什么东西想从这里出来仍是个谜。

我们的人民认为这是对一个深不可测的强大敌人的伟大胜利。
texts.en:
A gateway was nearly established in our capital system that placed our people in great danger.

Luckily, with technology we have gained from studying Astral Rifts, we were able to successfully seal this danger permanently.

Whatever was seeking to come through will remain a mystery.

Our people consider this a great victory over an unfathomably powerful enemy.

note.zh: 永久封印这个危险；该星系获得+10团结与+10物理研究矿藏；探索结束。花费500星界丝缕，且需“虫洞稳定”科技。
note.en: The danger is sealed permanently; the system gains a +10 unity and a +10 physics deposit; the exploration ends. Costs 500 astral threads and needs Wormhole Stabilization.

texts.zh:
我们通过锚链传输的电磁脉冲成功地让球体从束缚它的东西中挣脱出来。

传感器完全恢复运转，船员在他们的位置附近观察到一个气态实体；可能这就是它控制了这艘船。似乎电磁冲击使它丧失了能力，至少暂时是这样。

球体被固定在某种口袋维度中。我们被密集星云的旋涡云所包围。唯一检测到的其他实体就是附近的这个生物。

从震动中恢复过来后，它开始用一系列快速通信和信号轰炸球体。

我们的电脑和传感器信息过载，导航变得困难了起来。我们需要一些计算支持来理解我们接收到的信息。

我们尚不清楚在这里到底是不是受到了欢迎。
texts.en:
The E.M.P. we delivered through the anchor cord successfully jolted the Sphere free of whatever had taken control over it.

With sensors fully operational, the crew observed a gaseous entity directly nearby their location; presumably this is what had been controlling the vessel. It seemed that the jolt of energy has incapacitated it, at least for the time being.

The Sphere is being held in some sort of pocket dimension. We are surrounded on all sides by the swirling clouds of a dense nebula. The only other entity detected is the creature nearby.

After recovering from the shock, it has begun to bombard the Sphere with a series of rapid communications and signals.

Our computers and sensors have become overloaded with information, making navigation difficult. We will need some computational support to understand what we are receiving.

It is not clear that we are welcome here.

texts.zh:
我们通过锚链传输的电磁脉冲成功地让球体从束缚它的东西中挣脱出来。

船员都生龙活虎的，但没有人记得球体失控的事情。

传感器完全恢复运转，船员在他们的位置附近观察到一个气态实体；可能这就是它控制了这艘船。似乎电磁冲击使它丧失了能力，至少暂时是这样。

球体被固定在某种口袋维度中。我们被密集星云的旋涡云所包围。唯一检测到的其他实体就是附近的这个生物。

从震动中恢复过来后，它开始用一系列快速通信和信号轰炸球体。

我们的电脑和传感器信息过载，导航变得困难了起来。我们需要一些计算支持来理解我们接收到的信息。

我们尚不清楚在这里到底是不是受到了欢迎。
texts.en:
The E.M.P. we delivered through the anchor cord successfully jolted the Sphere free of whatever had taken control over it.

The crew is alive and well. However, none of them have any memory of losing control of the Sphere.

With sensors fully operational, the crew observed a gaseous entity directly nearby their location; presumably this is what had been controlling the vessel. It seemed that the jolt of energy has incapacitated it, at least for the time being.

The Sphere is being held in some sort of pocket dimension. We are surrounded on all sides by the swirling clouds of a dense nebula. The only other entity detected is the creature nearby.

After recovering from the shock, it has begun to bombard the Sphere with a series of rapid communications and signals.

Our computers and sensors have become overloaded with information, making navigation difficult. We will need some computational support to understand what we are receiving.

It is not clear that we are welcome here.

label.zh: 赶紧出来！我们只是暂时惊住了它。
label.en: Get out! We've only stunned it.

texts.zh:
在额外的计算支持下，我们处理了他们传输回的数据。这些数据其实是通讯，不是任何的攻击或什么别的。我们收到的数据是以一个运动图像序列讲述的故事。

这些图像中可以拼凑出我们整个星系的有赢，还有另一个小得多、但密度异常大的星系的图像。在两者之间，有一系列的星界裂隙。我们明白这是从我们的维度到另一个地方的路线图。

在我们星系的图像中，有一个小光点异常地突出。后来的分析证实这是我们的家园，[Explorer.GetHomeWorldName]，在闪闪发光。在邻近的宇宙中也发现了类似的光。

他们在告诉我们该去哪里。

为了避免数据损坏或丢失，我们接收的数据已经超出了计算机的合理处理能力。我们应该优先考虑我们想要保存的信息类型。
texts.en:
With the extra computational support, we have processed the data they are streaming to us. It is in fact a communication; it was not an attack of any kind. The data we are receiving tells us a story in a sequence of moving images.

A projection of our galaxy could be pieced together from the images, along with a second image of a much smaller, yet unusually dense system. Between the two, there stretched a series of Astral Rifts. We understood that this was a roadmap from our dimension to somewhere else.

A small point of light was abnormally highlighted inside the image of our galaxy. Later analysis confirmed this was our Homeworld, [Explorer.GetHomeWorldName], shining brightly. A similar light was discovered to be marked in the neighboring universe.

They are showing us where to go.

We're receiving more data than our computers can reasonably handle before it becomes corrupted or lost. We should prioritize the type of information we'd like to preserve.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的母星的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of your homeworld appears here.

texts.zh:
系统重新上线后，我们可以拉回锚链，从那个晶体裂隙里的生物处逃离。

我们不知道他们还会对我们施加什么进一步的操纵力量，但最好还是不要知道的好。

幸运的是，它在我们的船体上留下的残留物是极其密集的星界物质。
texts.en:
With our systems re-enabled, we've retracted the anchor cable and escaped from the creature inside of the Crystal Rift.

It is unknown what further powers of manipulation they would have deployed on us, and it is best not to find out.

On a fortunate note, the residue it left on the hull of our vessel is extremely dense with astral material.

note.zh: 撤回锚缆逃走：大量凝聚力与大量星界丝缕；探索结束。
note.en: The anchor cable is retracted and the Sphere escapes: a large unity income and a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

summary.text:
# 晶体裂隙 / The Crystal Rift

- 分类 Category：星界裂隙 Astral rifts (C4) · DLC：星界位面 Astral Planes

## 如何开始 How it starts

不是随机抽取的裂隙（`randomized = no`，标记 `crystal_rift`）：它只由“研究水晶球”情境完成时的事件 astral_situation.5 在水晶球星系生成（`astral_planes_situation_events.txt:61–71`；情境 `common/situations/06_astral_planes_situations.txt:268`）。探索它的是被派去的科学家，探球一到就被另一侧的存在抓住，收回装置失效。

Not a randomly drawn rift (`randomized = no`, flag `crystal_rift`): it is spawned in the crystal sphere system only by astral_situation.5 when the “Study the Crystal Sphere” situation completes (`astral_planes_situation_events.txt:61–71`; situation `common/situations/06_astral_planes_situations.txt:268`). On arrival the Sphere is seized by something on the far side and its retraction device is disabled.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 理解（1000）：用人工智能检测隐藏规律（→ 1005 家园），或花 1000 能量币对锚链释放电磁脉冲（→ 1010 重获控制）。
2. 1010：提供人工智能支援（→ 1006 家园，难度较高）或赶紧逃离（→ 1025 逃离，结束）。
3. 家园（1005 / 1006）：保存粒子或场操控数据（各给一项研究选项）→ 升腾（1015）：保存物理学或社会学数据 → 碎裂（1020）。
4. 碎裂（1020）：打开传送门，或封印它（需虫洞稳定科技与 500 星界丝缕 → 1030 封印，结束）。

1. Understanding (1000): use A.I. to check for hidden patterns (→ 1005 Home), or spend 1000 energy on an E.M.P. through the anchor cord (→ 1010 Taking Control).
2. 1010: provide A.I. assistance (→ 1006 Home, higher difficulty) or get out at once (→ 1025 Escape, end).
3. Home (1005 / 1006): preserve the particle or field-manipulation data (each gives a research option) → Ascendance (1015): preserve physics or society data → Shatter (1020).
4. Shatter (1020): open the doorway, or seal it (needs Wormhole Stabilization and 500 astral threads → 1030 The Seal, end).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 1025 逃离：大量凝聚力与星界丝缕。
- 1030 封印：该星系获得矿藏 d_crystal_rift。
- 打开传送门（1020.a）：立即结束探索；2 天后隐藏事件 1095 在银河核心生成形态之系统，用天然虫洞取代裂隙并销毁它，探索帝国获得标记 opened_wormhole_to_formless_system，再过 1 天出现“古怪虫洞”（astral_planes.45）。此后与形态之物的故事由其他故事线承接。

- 1025 Escape: a large unity income and astral threads.
- 1030 The Seal: the system gains the deposit d_crystal_rift.
- Opening the doorway (1020.a): the exploration ends at once; 2 days later hidden event 1095 spawns the Formless system at the galactic core, replaces the rift with a natural wormhole and destroys it, the explorer gets flag opened_wormhole_to_formless_system, and a day later “Strange Wormhole” (astral_planes.45) appears. The later Formless story continues elsewhere.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 1000 的正文对格式塔有变体；电磁脉冲选项需要 1000 能量币。
- 1020.b 需要虫洞稳定科技与 500 星界丝缕（花费）；AI 对灵性帝国不选封印，对排外且已具备条件的帝国不选打开传送门。

- The text of 1000 has a gestalt variant; the E.M.P. option needs 1000 energy.
- 1020.b needs Wormhole Stabilization and 500 astral threads (spent); spiritualist AI empires do not seal it, xenophobic AI empires that can afford it do not open the doorway.
